status: Published summary comparators; no reconstructed likelihood, detector model or joint fit
disclosure: Known public data guided the finite candidate choice. No blind validation or independent prediction is claimed. All numerical lattice controls are synthetic.

timing.title: Stringent Tests of Lorentz Invariance Violation from LHAASO Observations of GRB 221009A
timing.forward_model: Evolving GRB afterglow, EBL attenuation, detector response and FLRW propagation; bias calibration by shuffled data.
timing.limitations: One published subluminal quadratic bound is used. It is not combined with the calibrated or CCF intervals or turned into a Gaussian likelihood. The quoted 6.9e11 GeV value agrees with v2.

codata.title: NIST 2022 CODATA recommended values, current database on access date
codata.items: electron mass energy equivalent in MeV; fine-structure constant; inverse fine-structure constant; SI defining constants
codata.limitations: Adjusted parameters, not raw direct measurements. Correlations are not reproduced here; no joint calibration likelihood is formed.

fan.title: Electron magnetic moment from a Penning-trap frequency ratio
fan.limitations: Trap invariance, cavity and drive corrections are supplied; same-measurement extracted alpha in equation8 is not an independent datum.

parker.title: Measurement of the fine-structure constant as a test of the Standard Model
parker.items: Main pages1-2; alpha-squared extraction equation, recoil and uncertainty values
parker.limitations: Atomic recoil, cesium/electron mass ratio and Rydberg theory enter the alpha extraction. Joint covariance with the rubidium result is not available.

morel_preview.title: Determination of the fine-structure constant with an accuracy of81 parts per trillion
morel_preview.limitations: The downloaded27-page preview is not the full five-page paper; no raw data or reproduced likelihood.

morel_proceedings.title: Same-collaboration recoil extraction, Moriond2021 proceedings
morel_proceedings.limitations: This is the proceedings, not the Nature article; filename in runtime is historical. Shared mass/Rydberg uncertainties are not independent validations.

hess.title: High-statistics measurement of the cosmic-ray electron spectrum with H.E.S.S.
hess.limitations: No hadron subtraction. Above3TeV dominant hadron contamination cannot be excluded; highest-energy flux is an upper limit on true electrons. Event directions/response and covariance are not supplied here.

pdg.title: PDG2026 electron listing
pdg.limitations: Average and Fan single measurement remain distinct; no covariance was supplied to construct another average.

volkov.title: Electron anomalous magnetic moment tenth-order QED calculation
volkov.limitations: TotalC10=5.891(61), no-lepton-loop subset6.828(60), and g2-extracted alpha are different objects. None is used for an unperformed SM residual fit.

aoyama_revision.title: Revised tenth-order QED Set V contribution
aoyama_revision.limitations: Revised SetV6.800(128) is a subset, not totalC10. Not combined statistically with another subset or treated as an independent observation.

hashimoto.title: Relativistic heavy quarks on the anisotropic lattice
hashimoto.limitations: General vertices are convention context; fixed r_s/xi=1 specialization differs from conventional r_s=1 SW Hamiltonian limit. No numerical table imported.

angelides.title: Mass renormalization of the Schwinger model with Wilson and staggered fermions
angelides.items: Pages2-5; Hamiltonian, Gauss constraint and equation11
angelides.limitations: Different1+1-dimensional model; context only, no3+1 coefficient imported.

data.type: published 95 percent lower bound, ML MINOS quadratic subluminal case
data.uncertainty: One-sided model-dependent bound; no Gaussian error or raw likelihood inferred.
data.covariance: One analysis of one event; alternative calibration/CCF rows are not independent data.

data.type: flat LambdaCDM convention in the published timing extraction
data.uncertainty: Fixed by that extraction; no independent cosmological fit performed.

data.scale_scheme: physical rest energy; not a bare lattice mass or an MSbar running parameter
data.covariance: CODATA correlated adjustment; threshold sensitivity uses this datum alone.

data.scale_scheme: explicit tree-level coupling calibration; running and matching corrections not computed
data.covariance: Not assumed independent of electron calibration in a statistical fit.

data.type: spin/cyclotron frequency ratio after trap/cavity extraction
data.covariance: Single2023 value only; shared cavity systematic across eleven fields. No average with2008; alpha extracted from this same datum is not counted again.
Same experiment as cesium alpha below; never two independent likelihood factors.
Shared mass and Rydberg calibration with other extractions; full joint covariance unavailable.

data.scale_scheme: low-energy/on-shell coupling from recoil and supplied atomic/mass/Rydberg model
data.covariance: Conflicting with Cs determination; kept separate, no weighted average. Proceedings source documents extraction and systematics.

data.uncertainty: 10percent quoted energy-scale systematic; dominant hadron contamination above3TeV not excluded. No event-specific direction or energy likelihood imported.

data.type: electron-like sample, not all identified electrons
data.covariance: Same sample as endpoint; not used for a statistical fit.

frozen_grammar: w=1 spatial Wilson with a^2=1-mu tree matching
selection_and_complexity.fixed_model_choices: Continuous time, literal minimal links, Wilson w=1, noncompact Maxwell/Gauss sector, canonical quantum theory and vacuum. No fitted Wilson/clover coefficient.
selection_and_complexity.supplied_calibrations: Mass, charge and time/length units; an orientation and completion scale remain candidate parameters. Mass subtraction changes the existing mass-calibration map, not automatically the datum count.
selection_and_complexity.ranking_rule: Prefer the simpler relativistic null until an actual cross-family likelihood improvement is established. No numerical complexity score without a justified likelihood and selection measure.
